Every constructed orbit remains in the exact two-dimensional invariant subsystem; this is neither Lyapunov instability of a single fixed background nor a three-dimensional singularity result.

en: From R0.61 through R0.73M, this page retains all 129 nodes. zh: R0.73L 的两侧 selected-action 界把 R0.73H 中依赖未知实际增益的种子，重写为 \(\rho e^{-\Lambda\mathcal A_*}\phi_\Lambda\)。在完整 \(D_*=1/450\) 窗口上，endpoint-normalized forward orbit 的速率 \(\mu_*=0.167>1/6\) 使二次、三次与四阶能量账本分别留下 \(1/1500\)、\(1/1000\)、\(21/125\) 的严格裕度。
en: The two-sided selected-action bounds from R0.73L rewrite the seed in R0.73H, which depended on the unknown actual gain, as \(\rho e^{-\Lambda\mathcal A_*}\phi_\Lambda\). Over the full \(D_*=1/450\) window, the endpoint-normalized forward orbit has rate \(\mu_*=0.167>1/6\), leaving strict margins of \(1/1500\), \(1/1000\), and \(21/125\) in the quadratic, cubic, and fourth-order energy ledgers, respectively.

zh: R0.73L 的真实非自治 selected action 已接到固定端点的非线性谐波层级：prescribed-action seed、物理/kinetic 精确共轭、forward-orbit localization、二次与三次能量账本、四阶余项、固定距离终点和二维全局光滑性均已闭合。独立解析、对抗、文献、有限证书和正式附图分别通过；固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 继续 OPEN。
en: The genuine nonautonomous selected action from R0.73L is now connected to the fixed-endpoint nonlinear harmonic hierarchy: the prescribed-action seed, exact physical/kinetic conjugacy, forward-orbit localization, quadratic and cubic energy ledgers, fourth-order remainder, fixed-distance endpoint, and two-dimensional global smoothness are all closed. The independent analytic, adversarial, literature, finite-certificate, and formal-figure audits each passed; fixed-background dynamics, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73M 已把 R0.73L 的两侧 selected action 接到固定端点的非线性谐波层级：完整作用量指定种子、固定距离终点和二维全局光滑性均已闭合。下一关 R0.73N 只审计固定背景 Lyapunov 不稳定性的可行性与结构性障碍，不预设闭合。
en: R0.73M connects the two-sided selected action from R0.73L to the fixed-endpoint nonlinear harmonic hierarchy: the full-action prescribed seed, fixed-distance endpoint, and two-dimensional global smoothness are all closed. The next gate, R0.73N, audits only the feasibility and structural obstructions of fixed-background Lyapunov instability, without presupposing closure.

zh: R0.73M 用完整无黏 action 指定指数小种子，并以 \(\mu_*=0.167>1/6\) 的 forward localization 闭合二次、三次与四阶谐波能量账本；终点固定在物理时刻 \(T_*=1/1800\)，selected-pair 距离至少为 \(c_*\rho\)。
en: R0.73M uses the full inviscid action to prescribe an exponentially small seed and closes the quadratic, cubic, and fourth-order harmonic energy ledgers with forward localization at \(\mu_*=0.167>1/6\); the endpoint is fixed at physical time \(T_*=1/1800\), and the selected-pair distance is at least \(c_*\rho\).
